images.title: 52 bars or 4 lines
images.purpose: Compares the same space launch data as a crowded clustered column graph and as four clean lines.
images.composition: Two side by side panels of equal size: left is a dense clustered column graph in grey, right is a simple line graph with four labelled lines. A large caption under each panel. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Left panel: 13 clusters evenly spaced along a horizontal axis with no labels, each cluster holding 4 thin touching grey (#6B7280) columns, 52 columns in all; in each cluster the first column is tallest and the other three are much shorter, and the clusters grow taller from left to right. Caption under the left panel: '52 bars'. Right panel: the same horizontal axis with 13 evenly spaced positions and no labels. Four lines, each with 13 small points: a dark (#2B2B2B) line labelled 'World' at its right end, low at first, rising steeply in the later years to its highest at the 12th point and a little lower at the 13th; a teal (#0072B2) line labelled 'USA' that follows below the World line and rises in the later years; an amber (#E69F00) line labelled 'China' and a reddish purple (#CC79A7) line labelled 'Russia', both staying low and nearly flat near the bottom. Caption under the right panel: '4 lines'. No numbers on either panel.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Four lines show change over 13 years far more clearly than 52 bars.
images.description: Compares the same space launch data as a crowded clustered column graph and as four clean lines.
images.context: 13 years (2012 to 2024) times 4 series = 52 bars. World about 230 in 2016, about 2900 in 2023, about 2850 in 2024; USA about 2250 in 2024; China about 280; Russia about 120.
images.teaching_notes: Shapes are approximate, read from the graph; no values are labelled to keep it uncluttered.

image_decisions.why: This concept is a comparison of two displays, so a before and after pair is the clearest picture.
